prompt: A cinematic 15-second ultra-realistic travel vlog following a young female creator exploring Bangkok's vibrant street food scene. She walks through a lively daytime market, introduces the legendary Pad Thai, watches a skilled street chef prepare the dish with fresh ingredients, and captures detailed close-ups of sizzling noodles, colorful toppings, and authentic cooking moments. She tastes the freshly made Pad Thai and shares her genuine reaction while surrounded by the energy of local vendors and travelers. Handheld vlog realism, natural lip-sync, expressive emotions, cinematic food close-ups, realistic market atmosphere, bright tropical daylight, ARRI Alexa 35 aesthetic, HDR, immersive street sounds, premium travel documentary style, 4K photorealistic quality, seamless character consistency, no text, no logos.
